@FusionLogReplay.replay_complete_events : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (reference current : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered reference.placed →
      RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered current.placed →
        FusionLogReplay.packetSet current.placed = FusionLogReplay.packetSet reference.placed →
          ∃ route,
            FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F current route = FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F reference word ∧
              RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F current route).placed ∧
                FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F current route).placed =
                    FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F reference word).placed ∧
                  route.length ≤ (4 * n - 2) * (FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F reference word).length
@FusionLogReplay.sourceOrdered_log_endpoint_representative : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n))
  (s : FusionLogCompression.LoggedExecution n (ZMod n)) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered s.state.placed →
      ∃ representative,
        (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s representative).fullLog =
            (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s word).fullLog ∧
          (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s representative).state.placed =
              (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s word).state.placed ∧
            representative.length ≤
              (4 * n - 2) * (FusionLogReplay.eventTrace F s.state word).length +
                  (3 * n - (FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s.state word).placed).card) *
                    ((FusionLogReplay.packetSet (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s.state word).placed).card - 1) +
                (n - 1)
